Delhi launches four new tourism circuits for spiritual and heritage sites

The Delhi government has launched four new spiritual and heritage tourism circuits aimed at transforming the capital into a complete tourist destination. Chief Minister Rekha Gupta announced the initiative at the Spiritual & Heritage Tourism Conclave, stating that Delhi will now be recognized as a spiritual destination rather than just a transit city. The new circuits are intended to highlight the city's religious and cultural heritage and boost tourism.
